race.description: Band Of Brothers For The Kosciuszko Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: VETOED (11) had genuine excuses from poor gates at her last two outings and gets a better set-up for this with Spokes' claim. Sure to be thereabouts. VENDEMMIA (4) much better performance second up when he ploughed through the heavy going to finish third over 1250m at Ballina. Adept in all conditions and anticipating another big run. BELLARATA (8) made a good return when a close second at Murwillumbah last start over 1200m. In the mix. HAYLEY'S ROCKET (3) was a winner two starts back at this track then narrowly missed a repeat last start when second over 1100m at Murwillumbah. Include. THUNDEROUS (2) got home by 1.75 lengths at Gatton two starts ago but disappointed last time at Ballina when sixth. Well drawn and can atone.
